Plugin.Name: Disk Usage (duc)
Plugin.Overview: Fast disk usage analysis for Unraid, powered by duc (https://duc.zevv.nl). duc indexes your shares and disks on a schedule (by default daily, at low CPU and I/O priority) and stores the results in a database, so browsing is instant and the disks aren't rescanned every time you look. Browse from the webGUI under Settings, User Utilities, Disk Usage, with a sunburst chart and a sorted folder listing showing size on disk, apparent size or file count. Index several roots at once, for example /mnt/user for usage per share and /mnt/disk1 or /mnt/cache for usage per disk. The full duc command line is included too, including the duc ui terminal browser. Note: an index run reads directory metadata on every disk it covers, so spun-down disks will spin up during a run.
